preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain ownership)

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call setMaxWalletAmount() with a very large denominator (e.g., type(uint256).max) or a value that makes _tTotal / denominator = 0 due to integer division rounding down. This will set maxWalletAmount to zero, effectively preventing any non-excluded wallet from holding tokens and potentially causing a denial-of-service for regular users.
